 Asset Description : 
 A Load Tap Changer (LTC) is a switch inside a substation electrical transformer that can be manually or automatically adjusted to change the turns ratio of the transformer, thereby changing the output voltage. The OLTC (Oil-Immersed Tap Changing) is a type of LTC that is immersed in oil for cooling and insulation purposes. The main components of an OLTC include:

1. Contact assembly: This consists of the moving contacts and the stationary contacts, which make and break the electrical connection as the tap changer moves.
2. Tap changer mechanism: This is the mechanical component that moves the tap changer to the desired position.
3. Oil system: This provides cooling and insulation for the tap changer mechanism. It typically includes an oil tank, oil pump, and oil filter.
4. Control system: This is used to operate the tap changer manually or automatically. It may include a control panel, a tap changer drive, and a protection system.
